opening.argument: The speaker presents Quick Sale as an eBay-branded walkthrough for selling a smartphone, and the screen follows the transaction through phone details and condition. The described steps are concrete: select the device information, provide payment and shipping details, print a prepaid shipping label and packing slip, then ship the phone and receive payment. The PayPal and address request fits that stated payment-and-shipment process. The material does not establish a separate mechanism to divert money or the device, nor does it establish that payment was actually made. On the evidence shown, this is an ordinary phone-selling service walkthrough, not a demonstrated deceptive transaction.

citations.quote: Hello, my name is Andrew and I am part of the eBay Customer Service Team.
if you've chosen to sell your phone through quick cell will need to gather basic information such as your paypal account your shipping address
we'll direct you to print your prepaid free shipping label and packing slip, and then from there you pack it, ship it, and that's it.
A few clicks, ship it, and you get paid.
